Applying an edit: calls and required data
|
|-- [C] UI or agent bridge
|   `-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
|       |-- 1. Validate and stage
|       |   |-- [D] expected + current version -> conflict check
|       |   `-- [D] document + interaction state -> staged state
|       |-- 2. Apply operations
|       |   |-- Content changes -> DiagramService.create / revise
|       |   |   |-- [D] content + source evidence + base revision
|       |   |   `-- immutable revision + proven node correspondence
|       |   `-- Instance / view changes -> boxes / edges / sections / views
|       |-- 3. Derive consistent layout and presentation
|       |   |-- Grid layout and validation
|       |   |   |-- [D] ASCII dimensions + box hierarchy -> final cell bounds
|       |   |   `-- anchor changed box; push colliding siblings
|       |   |-- Connection reconciliation
|       |   |   `-- [D] content changes + correspondence
|       |   |       `-- retained / reanchored / stale endpoints
|       |   `-- Floating geometry
|       |       |-- [D] grid bounds + placement policies -> pixel bounds
|       |       `-- floating bounds never displace GridBoxes
|       `-- 4. Commit and publish
|           |-- [C] CanvasHistoryService.append
|           |   `-- [D] document + view + correspondence
|           |       `-- checkpoint + advanced version
|           `-- [C] Notify subscribers with updated snapshot
|               `-- session.onCommit() -> workspace persistence
|
|-- [M] commitDocument(...) commits document / layout edits
`-- [M] updateCanvas(...) / select(...) update interaction
    `-- Ordinary controls and measurements add no checkpoint

[C] indicates calls; [D] arrows indicate inputs needed for results.
Failure handling and transaction atomicity are not specified by the seed.
